options.name: ad_case_sensitive
options.description: Choose if username is case-sensitive or not. Supported for O(type=ad).

options.name: ad_domain
options.description: AD domain name. Required when O(type=ad).

options.name: api_host
options.description: Specify the target host of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_HOST) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_otp
options.description: Specify the OTP. Uses the E(PROXMOX_OTP) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_password
options.description: Specify the password to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PASSWORD) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_port
options.description: Specify the target port of the Proxmox VE cluster. Uses the E(PROXMOX_PORT) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Time limit for requests towards the Proxmox VE API.

options.name: api_token_id
options.description: Specify the token ID. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_token_secret
options.description: Specify the token secret. Uses the E(PROXMOX_TOKEN_SECRET) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: api_user
options.description: Specify the user to authenticate with. Uses the E(PROXMOX_USER) environment variable if not specified.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: Path to a local certificate, which will be used to verify TLS connections. Ignored if O(validate_certs=false).

options.name: comment
options.description: Description of the realm.

options.name: default
options.description: Use as default realm.

options.name: ldap_base_dn
options.description: LDAP base domain name. Required when O(type=ldap).

options.name: ldap_bind_dn
options.description: LDAP user bind domain name. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_filter
options.description: LDAP filter for user sync. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_group_classes
options.description: The object class for group (groupOfNames, group, univentionGroup, ipausergroup). Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_group_filter
options.description: LDAP filter for group sync. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_group_name_attr
options.description: LDAP group attribute name. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_mode
options.description: LDAP protocol mode. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_password
options.description: LDAP bind password. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_port
options.description: Server port. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_primary_server
options.description: Server ip address or dns name. Required when O(type=ldap) or O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_secondary_server
options.description: Fallback server ip address or dns name. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_sync_defaults_options
options.description: The defaults options for behavior of synchronizations. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_user_attr
options.description: LDAP user attribute name. Required when O(type=ldap).

options.name: ldap_user_classes
options.description: The object class for user (inetorgperson, posixaccount, person, user). Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: ldap_validate_certs
options.description: Verify the server's SSL certificate. Supported for O(type=ldap) and O(type=ad).

options.name: openid_acr_values
options.description: Defines the Authentication Context Class Reference values requested from the Authorization Server for the Authentication Request. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_autocreate
options.description: Automatically create users if they do not exist. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_client_id
options.description: OpenID Client ID. Required when O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_client_key
options.description: OpenID Client key. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_groups_autocreate
options.description: Automatically create users if they do not exist. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_groups_claim
options.description: OpenID claim used to retrieve groups with. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_groups_overwrite
options.description: All groups will be overwritten for the user on login. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_issuer_url
options.description: OpenID Issuer Url. Required when O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_prompt
options.description: Specifies whether the Authorization Server prompts the End-User for reauthentication and consent. Supported for with O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_query_userinfo
options.description: Enables querying the userinfo endpoint for claims values. Supported for with O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_scopes
options.description: Specifies the scopes (user details) that should be authorized and returned, for example 'email' or 'profile'. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: openid_username_claim
options.description: OpenID claim used to generate the unique username. Supported for O(type=openid).

options.name: realm
options.description: Arbitrary string used to identify the login realm in Proxmox.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates if the realm should be present or absent.

options.name: type
options.description: Realm type. Required when O(state=present).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate the TLS certificates used for the connection to the Proxmox VE API. May be set through the environment variable E(PROXMOX_VALIDATE_CERTS).
